fallback: If the button doesn't work, paste this address into your browser:

verify.subject: [{app}] Confirm your email address
verify.heading: Welcome, {name}.
verify.body: Press the button below to finish signing up.
verify.note: The link works for 24 hours. If you didn't sign up, you can ignore this email — no account is created until the address is confirmed.

reset.subject: [{app}] Reset your password
reset.heading: Reset your password
reset.body: Someone (hopefully you) asked to reset your password. Press the button to choose a new one.
reset.note: The link works once, for 30 minutes. If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email — your password stays the same.
reset.providers: You can also sign in to this account with {providers}.

existing.subject: [{app}] You already have an account
existing.heading: You already have an account
existing.body: Someone tried to sign up with this address. You already have an account, so you can just sign in.
existing.note: If you've forgotten your password, use 'Forgot password?' on the sign-in page. If this wasn't you, you can ignore this email.

invite.subject: [{app}] You're invited
invite.heading: You're invited to {app}
invite.body: {name} invited you to {app}. Press the button below to create your account.
invite.note: The link works once and expires after the period shown. If you weren't expecting this, you can ignore it.
